title_cyr: На срце ми стар мерак лежи
title_latin: Na srce mi star merak leži
title_en: An Old Longing Lies on My Heart
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear, no author I can name (poetic imagery suggests a modern song). 'Мерак' has no exact English equivalent; I render it 'longing'.

lines.cyr: На срце ми, на срце ми стар мерак лежи.
lines.lat: Na srce mi, na srce mi star merak leži.
lines.en: On my heart, on my heart lies an old longing.

lines.cyr: Eј љубов, љубов, од ѕвезди посеана,
lines.lat: Ej ljubov, ljubov, od dzvezdi poseana,
lines.en: Oh love, love, sown from the stars,

lines.cyr: од ѕвезди посеана, од сонце огреана.
lines.lat: od dzvezdi poseana, od sonce ogreana.
lines.en: sown from the stars, warmed by the sun.

lines.cyr: Ајде кажи, ајде кажи стара ле мајко,
lines.lat: Ajde kaži, ajde kaži stara le majko,
lines.en: Come, tell me, come, tell me, old mother,

lines.cyr: каде има, каде има лек за меракот?
lines.lat: kade ima, kade ima lek za merakot?
lines.en: where is there, where is there a cure for the longing?

lines.cyr: Eј љубов, љубов, од ѕвезди посеана,
lines.lat: Ej ljubov, ljubov, od dzvezdi poseana,
lines.en: Oh love, love, sown from the stars,

lines.cyr: од ѕвезди посеана, од сонце огреана.
lines.lat: od dzvezdi poseana, od sonce ogreana.
lines.en: sown from the stars, warmed by the sun.

lines.cyr: Ја послушај миле сине, стара си мајка,
lines.lat: Ja poslušaj mile sine, stara si majka,
lines.en: Listen to me, dear son, I am an old mother,

lines.cyr: нигде нема, нигде нема лек за меракот.
lines.lat: nigde nema, nigde nema lek za merakot.
lines.en: nowhere is there, nowhere is there a cure for the longing.
